method.method_draft: First describe the diagram as showing Earth at P and Q around the Sun. Use the text statement that Earth moves more slowly at P to identify P as near aphelion, i.e. early July/Northern Hemisphere summer. Since Beijing is in the Northern Hemisphere, at this time its noon Sun altitude is near the annual maximum. A high noon Sun angle makes direct sunlight enter the room at the steepest angle and cover the least floor area. Therefore Beijing's noon indoor sunlight area at P is the annual minimum.
